title: Find All K-Distant Indices in an Array
goal: Return every index within distance k of some key occurrence.
strategy: Each key occurrence covers an index interval. Since key positions arrive in order, append only the portion of each interval beyond the last covered index to avoid duplicates.

phasePurposes.start: Return every index within distance k of some key occurrence.
